value.rationale: This is a natural, exact boundary to the fixed-sample ULC preservation principle in randomly replicated Poisson counts. It shows instability under arbitrarily small random mixing, for all positive intensities, with an explicit universal asymptotic and no moment assumption on the rest of N. It is not a chosen numerical slice or a trivial reparameterization; it distinguishes fixed-size order-statistic closure from stochastic replication.
